notes: A stated endless runner with auto-run forward, so Infinite Runner and its genre-wide P6, which the elastic obstacle spacing needs anyway since speed rises over time. lane-snap rather than the genre default lane-free because the prompt says switch lanes, which is the discrete Subway Surfers fork rather than continuous steering. Kept the Lane Runner preset's shape, chunk-modular and collectible-nodes but dropped obstacle-moving, since the prompt asks only to dodge obstacles and repeatedly forbids scope expansion; added obstacle-jump for the swipe-up hurdles and hazard-kill because crashing ends the run outright. Without a user I read the answers' abstract clean arcade look and few-hundred-stud recycled segment as the chunk unit, which is what trigger-despawn places, and left the best-distance HUD readout to UI rather than adding marker-distance geometry.
